skill.summary: Agent发现探索助手。搜索、评估、集成公开Agent。使用场景：(1) 搜索可用Agent，(2) 评估Agent能力，(3) 集成方案设计，(4) 成本效益分析。

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of agent-discovery.

- Enables users to search, evaluate, and integrate publicly available agents.
- Supports capabilities search, agent ability comparison, integration solution guidance, and cost-effectiveness analysis.
- Provides usage examples for each main scenario in Chinese.
